name: New Orleans 2024
information: This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing LLC](https://www.southerncubing.com/). Make sure to check out [Louisiana Speedcubing's Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1025679060833637) for upcoming competitions and announcements! To learn more about Cubing in the US South, including other competitions, visit www.southerncubing.com. - Please review the [competitor information] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewOrleans2024#49443-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewOrleans2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule
